pixel_description: Photorealistic exploded stack pressed by adult fingertip from top. Top: fingertip dents center of matte grey ridged circular disc about one-third stack width. Disc touches central grey vertically-ribbed block recessed between left/right light-grey rounded side blocks. Below side blocks a thin green wavy strip spans full width dented down center. Below that a thin clear translucent wavy membrane spans full width dented center. Below membrane a dense array of translucent white vertical pillars standing on flat green PCB: outer rows tall double-segmented columns, inner rows shorter bulbous tips more compressed center under dent, roughly 30-40+ elements in grid rows, bases on green PCB, tips touching/nearly touching underside of translucent membrane. That flat green PCB is flat full-width. Below it air gap with left metal coil standoff, then second flat green PCB with black chips and copper traces, right edge joined to orange-brown flat flex tail looping out right and down in S-curve. Below second PCB air gap then light-grey rectangular block, then two vertical silver threaded screws with cross heads through air gap to black rectangular base below. Critical pillars: drawn as two arrays - upper grey short ribs ~20 under skin plus lower white translucent pillars ~30-40 vertical grid between membrane and lower green PCB, not single soft silicone x48 between film and single flat PCB; upper array compressed center, lower outer tall inner short. Beige callout boxes left/right with thin leaders.

comparison_with_previous: Compared with previous render (third image) none of the 5 earlier faults are fixed: skin is still a narrow isolated ridged disc not full-width cap, upper green board is still wavy dented, there are still two pillar-like arrays with a translucent membrane between an upper and lower green board, and Taxel leader still ends mid-array/flex joint not on green PCB. Lower array color changed from silver-black telescopic pins to translucent white pillars but duplicate-array architecture persists, so still_wrong not fixed. New faults introduced: right-side callouts now carry numbers/symbols and extra state words e.g. 4-wire FFC Tail (PWR/GND/SDA/SCL), Silicone Pillar Array compressed, Taxel Electrode Board upper PCB, Matte Silicone Cap (ridged), and PVDF/pillar leaders misplaced onto side block/film.

s1_differences: Stack order and parts wrong vs sketch: two pillar arrays (grey ribs + white pillars) with two green boards and membrane between them vs single soft-pillar array between single film and single flat rigid electrode board; upper green board bent with dent vs rigid flat; skin narrow isolated disc vs full-width ridged cap; callouts misplaced and numeric (PVDF onto side block, pillars onto film, Taxel onto mid-array, tail with 4-wire/PWR/GND/SDA/SCL). Exploded gaps themselves are illustration but duplicate/wavy/narrow geometry changes sensing spring and coverage.
s2_feedback: No separate design flaw judged because render is unfaithful; when corrected to sketch order skin-film-pillars-pcb-core-screws-holder with rear tail exit, load path can carry 30N grip to 139N proof without tail pinch. Apparent gaps at readout-core-base are exploded-view separations aligned by vertical screws, not assembly interference.
notes: Exploded vertical gaps between boards/core/base are illustration, not counted as connection faults; touch-apart segmenter flags treated as matters=false. Size: ridged disc ~ fingertip width plausible ~20mm but full PCB/core/base width ~2.5x finger width implies ~45-50mm cartridge, oversize vs 20mm fingertip spec, supporting skin-coverage fault.
